title: Man. Post. Cap. II: question of strict sense; two questions ahead; before Cap. III
pass_a_gloss: But it is asked among us only whether it is a penalty in that sense which I explained, most proper and strict. These two questions, because you did not separate them, that opportunity may arise, following your footsteps, God favoring, I will treat.
pass_b_english: Among us the sole live question is whether it is penalty in that most proper, strict sense I just marked out. You did not keep the two questions apart. God willing, I will take them up in turn as the chance comes, following your own steps.
source_text: Sed quaeritur inter nos duntaxat, num sit poena sensu illo, quem explicavi, maxime proprio & stricto. Has duas quaestiones, quia tu non separasti, ut feret occasio, tua sequens vestigia, Deo favente, tractabo.

choices.choice: Stop before Cap. III; keep two-questions deferral

notes: Cap. II Posterior quaestio de poena densify section 205 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 185 tip–186 tip).
